The quickest start is a Combustion Plant: put coal or charcoal in and it makes {fe:40} FE/t straight away.
The better setup is a Firebox feeding a Thermoelectric Plant. The Firebox burns the same fuel into heat, up to 1,100°C; the Thermoelectric Plant turns heat into FE, and the hotter the heat, the more FE it gets. Together they make about twice the FE per coal.
# Setting it up
- Place them touching, with the Firebox's heat face against the plant's heat face, or join them with Thermodynamic Conduits.
- The plant takes a few minutes to warm up.
- Take FE out of the plant's energy face with Energy Conduits.
